verdict.rationale: The pack never documents how LiveKit's media layer (SFU) scales across nodes or regions. It has no material on multi-node clustering, cross-region routing, or managed autoscaling of media servers. Kubernetes/Docker deployment, agent hosting on LiveKit Cloud, and region-restricted telephony trunks are adjacent features, not documentation of media-layer scaling.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering
